name: Camp Shalom
description_short: A traditional day camp run by the Mandell JCC on 75 wooded acres along the Farmington River in Windsor, open to everyone. Campers swim in a pool and the river, boat, water ski and fish, and also do sports, archery, a climbing wall and ropes course, and arts such as ceramics and woodworking.
special_needs_notes: An Inclusion Program with an Inclusion Specialist helps campers with disabilities or specific needs take part. Campers with a current IEP may join the Learning Hut tutoring program. Families should talk with the camp director before registering.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp has a pool and a riverfront on the Farmington River, with Red Cross certified instructional swim and free swim, plus boating, water skiing and tubing.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Sessions and rates page: summer 2027 runs June 21 to August 13 in four two week sessions; registration opens in January and no 2027 rates are posted yet. Units by grade entering in fall 2027 from kindergarten to grade 9, CIT for grade 10. Camp day 9:30 am to 3:30 pm (the FAQ says 9:00). Buses from the Mandell JCC in West Hartford and other central spots, kosher nut free lunch and snacks, and after care are included or offered.
